summary: Work alongside agents while they run: talk, see who is working, steer one, and approve what they ask.
intent: Block: a live session with running agents. The conversation (Chat) beside who is working (RunningNow), the oldest open approval (ApprovalCard) and steering for one agent (AgentSteering).
useWhen: a workspace where people chat with agents as they work
redirect or pause an agent mid-run without leaving the conversation
approve an agent's action in the flow of the chat
doNotUseWhen: many agents since your last look — AgentOverview

messages.note: Chat messages: { id?, role: "user" | "assistant", content, timestamp? }[].

agents.note: { id, name, status: "running" | "waiting" | "paused" | "failed" | "done", activity?, meta?, elapsed?, suggestions?, applied? }[]. Not-done agents are in Working now.

requests.note: { id, agentId, title, description?, risk?, action }[] oldest first. The first is an inline ApprovalCard; the rest are counted.

thinking.note: The chat shows the kit thinking state.

suggestions.note: Prompt chips over the chat composer.

defaultSelectedAgentId.note: Uncontrolled starting agent. Default: the first agent still working.

onSelectAgent.note: (agentId) => void. A Working now row was picked; steering moves to it.

onStop.note: (agentId) => void. After a kit AlertDialog confirm.

layout: left: Chat; right: RunningNow (stack), the open ApprovalCard, AgentSteering for the steered agent; in layout-split--primary
the block is its own inline-size container; below --grid-breakpoint-md (64rem) of block width the right column stacks under the chat

requirements: section aria-labelledby the h2 title; place it inside the page's <main>
Working now rows are buttons naming the agent and its status; picking one moves steering to it
the open approval is a section labelled "<agent> asks", with how many more wait
the chat thread is a live log; the steer composer is named "Steer <agent>"
Stop confirms in a kit AlertDialog
no motion of its own; the parts' motion is transform and opacity and off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not rebuild LiveSession from local panels; import the block
Do not show every open request at once; one inline approval, the rest counted
Only one solid primary in the view: the chat send, or the approval's approve while one waits (the chat send and the steer send go soft)
snippet: <LiveSession messages={messages} agents={agents} requests={requests} onSend={send} onSteer={steer} onApprove={approve} onDeny={deny} />
